_about: William Ralph Boyce Gibson (1869-1935), personal idealist, later professor of philosophy at Melbourne. Raw IA OCR: A Philosophical Introduction to Ethics (London: Swan Sonnenschein, 1904), God with Us, a study in religious idealism (London: A. and C. Black, 1909), The Problem of Logic, with the co-operation of Augusta Klein (A. and C. Black, first published 1908; this the reprint of November 1914) and Rudolf Eucken's Philosophy of Life (A. and C. Black, 1915 printing). His translations of Eucken with Lucy Judge Gibson are translations of a German author and are left to the translator lane. US public domain. No uids minted.
